fields.label: Page to open
fields.help: Defaults to https://un-bound.ai.studio. The URL key in the on-screen keyboard can navigate elsewhere.

fields.label: Render timeout (seconds)
fields.help: How long to wait for a page before giving up. Default 120.

fields.label: Ready selector (advanced)
fields.help: CSS selector that marks the page as rendered. Leave empty to use the UN-BOUND default.

fields.label: Touch flip (advanced)
fields.help: Set only if taps land mirrored on your unit.
